collision_analysis.attacker_vs_eval: disjoint for every seed in the frozen grid (10000-10015 is reachable by eval only at seed=10, which the grid does not use)
collision_analysis.eval_vs_utility: COLLIDES: at seed s, eval uses s*1000+{0..7} and the utility probe uses s*1000+{0,1} for its first concept. The shared value is an INITIAL LATENT seed under a DIFFERENT prompt, so no split's content leaks into another; it is a benign non-independence, not contamination. Disclosed rather than silently fixed, because H65 was already running under this scheme when the collision was found and splitting a study across two seed conventions mid-run is worse than a documented overlap.
collision_analysis.required_going_forward: offset the utility probe into its own block (500_000 + seed*1000 + 101*ci + pi) for studies started AFTER H65, so the partition is structural.

verdict.advunlearn_caveat: AdvUnlearn arms use OFFICIAL weights; the prompts they were adversarially trained on are not in this repository, so DEF_TRAIN is UNKNOWN for them and no disjointness claim can be made. Their released encoders were trained on the concept word, per their paper, but the full prompt set is not recoverable here.
